activity.notes: Upon Alaska's admission as a state on 3 January 1959, Bartlett's U.S. Senate term began for Alaska; he remained in office until his death on 11 December 1968. ATLAS treats Alaska as the represented political community and uses serves, not rules.

sources.title: States in the Senate — Alaska Senators
sources.citation_text: The U.S. Senate records E. L. (Bob) Bartlett's Alaska Senate service from 3 January 1959 to 11 December 1968.

sources.title: BARTLETT, Edward Lewis (Bob) — U.S. House of Representatives: History, Art & Archives
sources.citation_text: The official congressional biography records Bartlett's Senate term beginning with Alaska statehood on 3 January 1959 and ending at his death on 11 December 1968.
